test_title: PYST 54: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is Option (2) i.e. '**anxiety**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• '**Anxiety**' is the most appropriate option because it is **a common emotional reaction to stress**, which aligns with the context of unfavourable emotional reactions elicited by the experience of stress.
 
• The passage discusses **the emotional responses to stress, and anxiety **is a well-documented emotional response to stress and discrimination.

​Therefore, the correct answer is **'anxiety'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• '**Death**' and '**deafness**' refer to extreme and specific conditions that** are not** directly implied as immediate emotional reactions to stress in the context provided.
 
• '**Impairment**' is a general term and does not specifically fit the context of emotional reactions as neatly as 'anxiety' does.
 
 
• **Deafness **(बहरापन) - The condition of lacking the power of hearing or having impaired hearing. 
 
• **Impairment** (क्षति) - A state of being diminished, weakened, or damaged, especially mentally or physically. 
 
 

Complete passage is: Discrimination refers to the inequitable or (1)biased__ treatment of individuals or collectives on the basis of attributes such as ethnicity, sex, age and sexual orientation. Studies have indicated that the perception of discrimination can (2)__trigger__ a series of stress-induced alterations in an individual's mental, physiological and behavioural responses. The experience of stress is known to elicit unfavourable emotional reactions, including but not limited to (3)**__anxiety__**, despair and resentment. Furthermore, anxiety has been linked to a rise in health-compromising behaviours such as smoking, drinking and (4)________ drug use, while simultaneously causing a (5)________ in health-promoting activities such as quality sleep and vigorous exercise.
